title: Anxiety Test
description: Find out your level of anxiety and how it affects your body and mind day to day.

questions.sas_1: I feel more nervous and anxious than usual.
questions.sas_2: I feel afraid for no clear reason.
questions.sas_3: I get upset easily or feel panicky.
questions.sas_4: I feel like I'm falling apart or going to pieces.
questions.sas_5: I feel that everything is all right and nothing bad will happen.
questions.sas_6: My arms and legs shake and tremble.
questions.sas_7: I am bothered by headaches, neck pain, or back pain.
questions.sas_8: I feel weak and get tired easily.
questions.sas_9: I feel calm and can sit still easily.
questions.sas_10: I can feel my heart beating fast.
questions.sas_11: I am often bothered by dizzy spells.
questions.sas_12: I feel like I'm going to faint.
questions.sas_13: I can breathe in and out easily.
questions.sas_14: My fingers and toes feel numb or tingly.
questions.sas_15: I am bothered by stomach aches or indigestion.
questions.sas_16: I feel I have to urinate often.
questions.sas_17: My hands are usually warm and dry.
questions.sas_18: My face feels hot and flushed.
questions.sas_19: I fall asleep easily and get a good night's rest.

Your anxiety is quite high and interferes with daily functioning.
